items.source:
Create a new accessor for the given object,
registering a nested path that the object is in.
items.translation: 为给定对象创建一个新的访问器，并注册该对象所在的嵌套路径。

items.source:
Switch the target object, replacing the cached introspection results only
if the class of the new object is different to that of the replaced object.
items.translation: 切换目标对象，仅在新对象的类与被替换对象的类不同时，才替换缓存的内省结果。

items.source: object - the object wrapped by this accessor
items.translation: object - 此访问器包装的对象

items.source: nestedPath - the nested path of the object
items.translation: nestedPath - 对象的嵌套路径

items.source: Returns false if the property doesn't exist.
items.translation: 如果属性不存在，则返回false。

items.source: rootObject - the root object at the top of the path
items.translation: rootObject - 路径顶部的根对象

items.source: object - the new target object
items.translation: object - 新的目标对象

items.source: propertyName - the property to check (may be a nested path and/or an indexed/mapped property)
items.translation: propertyName - 要检查的属性（可以是嵌套路径和/或索引/映射属性）

items.source: This accessor will convert collection and array values to the corresponding target collections or arrays, if necessary. Custom property editors that deal with collections or arrays can either be written via PropertyEditor's setValue, or against a comma-delimited String via setAsText, as String arrays are converted in such a format if the array itself is not assignable.
items.translation: 此访问器将在必要时将集合和数组值转换为相应的目标集合或数组。处理集合或数组的自定义属性编辑器可以通过 PropertyEditor 的setValue编写，或者针对逗号分隔的 String 通过setAsText编写；如果数组本身不可赋值，则会将 String 数组转换为该格式。

items.source: Called by PropertyEditorRegistrySupport.findCustomEditor(Class, String) if no required type has been specified, to be able to find a type-specific editor even if just given a property path.
items.translation: 由 PropertyEditorRegistrySupport.findCustomEditor(Class, String) 调用，如果未指定所需类型，则即使仅给定属性路径，也能找到特定类型的编辑器。

items.source: The default implementation always returns null. BeanWrapperImpl overrides this with the standard getPropertyType method as defined by the BeanWrapper interface.
items.translation: 默认实现始终返回null。 BeanWrapperImpl 使用 BeanWrapper 接口定义的标准的getPropertyType方法覆盖此行为。

items.source: Default is unlimited on a plain accessor.
items.translation: 默认情况下，普通访问器的限制为无限制。

items.source: Return the AbstractNestablePropertyAccessor.PropertyHandler for the specified propertyName, navigating if necessary. Return null if not found rather than throwing an exception.
items.translation: 返回指定 `propertyName` 的AbstractNestablePropertyAccessor.PropertyHandler，必要时进行导航。如果未找到则返回 `null`，而不是抛出异常。
